# Examples

Every example here is a script you can run: the strategies are in the chart's picker under **Strategies**, and the
indicators are the chart's built-in indicators. The source on each page is the exact file the platform runs.

## Strategies

| Strategy | Resolution | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Block scalper](./block_scalper_1b) | 1B | Block-level scalper for the 1B (bar per block) mode |
| [Bollinger breakout](./bollinger_breakout) | 15m | Buys a volume-confirmed close above the upper Bollinger band, exits on an ATR trail or the basis |
| [DCA with liquidity guard](./dca_liquidity_guard) | 1h | Dollar-cost averages into the pool only while liquidity is deep |
| [EMA cross on alpha](./ema_cross) | 15m | Buys a fast/slow EMA cross up while the pool is deep enough, exits on the cross down |
| [Moving-price discount](./moving_price_discount) | 15m | Buys when the pool trades below the protocol's moving price |
| [Moving-price momentum](./moving_price_momentum) | 15m | Trades momentum in the moving price |
| [Regime switch](./regime_switch) | 1h | Switches between mean-reversion and trend rules by volatility (ATR / price) |
| [RSI mean reversion](./rsi_mean_reversion) | 15m | Buys oversold RSI with a price limit, sells when RSI recovers |
| [Session DCA](./session_dca_capacity) | 1h | Scheduled buys sized to the pool's capacity |
| [Supertrend follow](./supertrend_follow) | 1h | Long while Supertrend points up, flat while it points down |
| [Whale flow](./whale_flow) | 15m | Reacts to large pool trades (onTrade) |

## Built-in indicators

### Moving averages

| Indicator | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| [Moving Average Exponential](./indicators/ema) | Exponentially weighted mean, reacts faster than SMA |
| [Moving Average Simple](./indicators/sma) | Arithmetic mean of the last N closes |
| [Volume Weighted Moving Average](./indicators/vwma) | Mean weighted by each bar's alpha volume |
| [Moving Average Weighted](./indicators/wma) | Linearly weighted mean of the last N values |

### Bands & channels

| Indicator | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| [Bollinger Bands](./indicators/bbands) | SMA basis with standard-deviation bands |
| [Donchian Channels](./indicators/donchian) | Highest high and lowest low of N bars |
| [Envelope](./indicators/envelope) | SMA with fixed percentage bands |
| [Keltner Channels](./indicators/keltner) | EMA basis with ATR bands |

### Trend

| Indicator | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| [Average Directional Index](./indicators/adx) | Trend strength (Wilder), 0 to 100 |
| [Supertrend](./indicators/supertrend) | ATR trailing line that flips with the trend |
| [VWAP](./indicators/vwap) | Volume weighted average price, anchored to the UTC day |

### Oscillators

| Indicator | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| [Average True Range](./indicators/atr) | Average true range (volatility) |
| [Commodity Channel Index](./indicators/cci) | Deviation from the mean in units of mean deviation |
| [MACD](./indicators/macd) | EMA difference, signal line and histogram |
